description: Reduced decoder width from d=16/ff=48 to d=14/ff=42 with two layers retained.
proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: 14 hidden channels and a proportional 42-unit MLP retain enough digit and carry-state capacity, lowering the count from the 6,080-parameter incumbent.

description: Reduced only the two feed-forward hidden layers from ff=48 to ff=44 at d=16, h=2, L=2.
proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: carry and position identities require the incumbent 16-channel residual stream, but four MLP features per block are redundant; reducing ff from 48 to 44 should save 128 unique parameters without changing attention.

description: Further reduced feed-forward width from ff=44 to ff=40 while retaining d=16, h=2, and two layers.
proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: the accepted ff=44 model has spare MLP capacity beyond carry-state transformation requirements, so removing four more features per block may still meet the official 99% threshold while retaining the full residual and attention widths.

description: Replaced the learned 35-position embedding table with deterministic sinusoidal positional encoding at d=16, ff=40.
proposal: Representational substitution hypothesis: addition uses a fixed, short positional layout, so parameter-free sinusoidal absolute positions should preserve operand/output alignment while removing the learned 35-by-16 positional table from the 5,568-parameter incumbent.

description: Removed LayerNorm affine scale and bias in both transformer blocks and the final normalization, retaining d=16 and ff=40.
proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: the fixed normalization statistics are sufficient for this narrow, fixed-format task, making the learned per-channel LayerNorm scale and shift redundant; remove all five affine LayerNorm parameter pairs while preserving normalization and the accepted architecture.
